verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any capability to select many notes and act on them at once, such as bulk edit, tag, move, delete or transform. Several features sit nearby but do not count as bulk operations: migration imports and exports, Kindle sync creating many notes, and chatting with a filtered set of notes, which is read-only Q&A. The API only appends to the daily note, creates single notes and handles links, with no batch endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
